```{python}
# | tags: [setup]
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import board
import charts
from board import HELP, SETUP_CHECKS, tip
from charts import html_table, plain, signed

px_all, meta, M = board.load()


def series(ticker):
    return px_all[px_all["ticker"] == ticker]
```

```{python}
Markdown(f"<p class='stamp'>Last bar **{meta['last_bar']}** · fetched {meta['fetched_at_utc']} · "
         f"{meta['ok']}/{meta['requested']} tickers</p>")
```

```{python}
STRIP = [("SPY", "S&P 500", None), ("QQQ", "Nasdaq 100", None), ("^VIX", "VIX", None),
         ("^VIX3M", "VIX3M", None), ("^TNX", "10Y yield", "tnx"),
         ("DX-Y.NYB", "Dollar", None)]

cards = []
for sym, label, key in STRIP:
    if sym not in M.index:
        continue
    r = M.loc[sym]
    lbl = tip(label, key) if key else label
    cards.append(f'<div class="stat"><div class="label">{lbl}</div>'
                 f'<div class="value">{r["close"]:,.2f}</div>'
                 f'<div class="delta">{signed(r["ret_1d"] * 100)}</div></div>')

# Volatility stress: VIX3M/VIX below 1 = front-month fear exceeds longer-dated.
if {"^VIX", "^VIX3M"} <= set(M.index):
    ratio = M.loc["^VIX3M", "close"] / M.loc["^VIX", "close"]
    cards.append(f'<div class="stat"><div class="label">{tip("VIX3M / VIX", "vix_ratio")}</div>'
                 f'<div class="value">{ratio:.2f}</div>'
                 f'<div class="delta {"down" if ratio < 1 else "up"}">'
                 f'{"stressed" if ratio < 1 else "calm"}</div></div>')

# Equal-weight vs cap-weight: is the average stock leading the mega-caps?
if {"RSP", "SPY"} <= set(M.index):
    rot = (M.loc["RSP", "ret_1m"] - M.loc["SPY", "ret_1m"]) * 100
    cards.append(f'<div class="stat"><div class="label">{tip("RSP − SPY 1M", "rsp_spy")}</div>'
                 f'<div class="value">{rot:+.2f}%</div>'
                 f'<div class="delta {"up" if rot >= 0 else "down"}">'
                 f'{"broad" if rot >= 0 else "narrow"}</div></div>')

HTML(f'<div class="stat-strip">{"".join(cards)}</div>')
```

## Watchlist

```{python}
def setup_cell(r):
    """n/6 with the individual checks in the tooltip."""
    detail = " · ".join(
        f"{'PASS' if ok else ('n/a' if ok is None else 'fail')} {label}"
        for (label, _), ok in zip(SETUP_CHECKS, r["setup_results"]))
    n = r["setup_n"]
    cls = "up" if n >= 5 else ("down" if n <= 2 else "")
    return f'<abbr class="gl {cls}" title="{detail}">{n}/6</abbr>'


WL_SPEC = [
    ("close",       "Close",                               lambda v: plain(v, 2)),
    ("ret_1d",      "1D",                                  lambda v: signed(v * 100)),
    ("ret_1w",      tip("1W", "ret_1w"),                   lambda v: signed(v * 100)),
    ("ret_1m",      tip("1M", "ret_1m"),                   lambda v: signed(v * 100)),
    ("rs_1m",       tip("RS 1M", "rs_1m"),                 lambda v: signed(v, 1)),
    ("rs_3m",       tip("RS 3M", "rs_3m"),                 lambda v: signed(v, 1)),
    ("rsi",         tip("RSI", "rsi"),                     lambda v: plain(v, 0)),
    ("atr_ext",     tip("ATR ext", "sma50_atr_ext"),       lambda v: plain(v, 1)),
    ("pct_off_52w", tip("Off 52w hi", "pct_off_52w_high"), lambda v: signed(v, 1)),
    ("adr",         tip("ADR", "adr"),                     lambda v: plain(v * 100 if pd.notna(v) else v, 1, "%")),
    ("rel_vol",     tip("Rel vol", "rel_vol"),             lambda v: plain(v, 2)),
]

# Sorted by setup score, then relative strength: the morning question is
# "which of these is set up right now", not "which moved yesterday".
wl = M[M["group"] == "watchlist"].sort_values(["setup_n", "rs_1m"], ascending=False)

HTML(html_table(wl, WL_SPEC, first_header=tip("Setup", "setup_checklist"),
                first_cell=lambda tk, r: f"{tk} {setup_cell(r)}"))
```

```{python}
ETF_SPEC = [
    ("close",       "Close",                               lambda v: plain(v, 2)),
    ("ret_1d",      "1D",                                  lambda v: signed(v * 100)),
    ("ret_1w",      tip("1W", "ret_1w"),                   lambda v: signed(v * 100, 1)),
    ("ret_1m",      tip("1M", "ret_1m"),                   lambda v: signed(v * 100, 1)),
    ("rs_1m",       tip("RS 1M", "rs_1m"),                 lambda v: signed(v, 1)),
    ("rsi",         tip("RSI", "rsi"),                     lambda v: plain(v, 0)),
    ("pct_off_52w", tip("Off 52w hi", "pct_off_52w_high"), lambda v: signed(v, 1)),
]
HTML(html_table(M[M["group"] == "etf"].sort_values("ret_1m", ascending=False), ETF_SPEC))
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Glossary"}

```{python}
KEYS = ["setup_checklist", "sma50_atr_ext", "lod_atr_pct", "sma200_rising",
        "sma10_rising", "rs_1m", "rs_3m", "rel_vol", "pct_off_52w_high", "rsi",
        "adr", "vix_ratio", "rsp_spy", "tnx"]
LABELS = {"setup_checklist": "Setup score", "sma50_atr_ext": "ATR extension",
          "lod_atr_pct": "LoD distance", "sma200_rising": "200-MA rising",
          "sma10_rising": "10-MA rising", "rs_1m": "RS 1M", "rs_3m": "RS 3M",
          "rel_vol": "Relative volume", "pct_off_52w_high": "Off 52-week high",
          "rsi": "RSI", "adr": "ADR", "vix_ratio": "VIX3M / VIX",
          "rsp_spy": "RSP − SPY", "tnx": "10Y yield"}
items = "".join(f"<dt>{LABELS[k]}</dt><dd>{HELP[k]}</dd>" for k in KEYS if k in HELP)
HTML(f"<dl class='glossary'>{items}</dl>")
```

```{python}
# Build fingerprint. data/ is never published, so without this there is no way
# to tell from the live page whether a disagreement with a local render comes
# from different upstream history or from a code change.
cal_len = meta.get("calendar_len")
bars = meta.get("bars_per_ticker", {})
off = sorted(t for t, v in bars.items() if v != cal_len)
Markdown(f"<p class='stamp'>Build: {cal_len} sessions · {len(bars)} tickers · "
         f"{len(off)} off SPY's calendar ({', '.join(off) if off else 'none'})</p>")
```
